about_the_game:
This is a roguelike card game that anyone can play, themed around the world of the Chinese zodiac. There are lots of cute, fun, and quirky cards!Each of the twelve zodiac characters has its own unique characteristics, so you can start with your own zodiac sign or your favorite character. The map, cards, enemy characters, and more all change randomly each time.

The rules are simple: you win by reducing the enemy leader's HP to zero with the attack power of each card! In addition to battle squares against enemies, the map also features shop squares where you can purchase cards of your choice, gacha squares where you can obtain random cards, and event squares where good and bad events occur, making for a variety of encounters that will lead to new adventures.
